newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul to help banks if they face fund shortage.
newsitem.headline: Seoul to help banks if they face fund shortage.

text.p: South Korea's Finance and Economy Minister Kang Kyong-shik said on Tuesday the government would take necessary steps if local banks faced fund shortages.
"The government will actively take necessary steps if individual financial institutions face difficulty in their fund operations," Kang said in a prepared speech. He gave no details.
The text of the speech, due to be delivered in a meeting with the nation's top bankers later on Tuesday, was released in advance.
The government also would help local banks raise funds from overseas, he said without elaborating.
